'''Lassa Nibs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] and a [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, [[Boffen Nibs|Boffen]], her son, stole a large [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] known as the [[Eye of Corell]] from her which traced their family line back for many generations. He stole the diamond due to a wish for excitement and adventure, and planned to use it to fund the beginnings of a criminal career.
